title: Section 3: Governance
slide_intent: Mark the change from building an identity to understanding its conditions of use. A visible pause lets the reader recognize a new kind of material before reading it.
strategic_value: Slack can organize a long book with its aubergine field and a single section label.
demonstration: A small white section heading sits near the top of a full aubergine page. A thin pale rule spans the page beneath it; the remaining field is open.
practical_value: Use a section divider at a real change of purpose. Preserve the open field and the same left margin used by the instructional pages.

content_islands.name: Section label and rule
content_islands.spec: Place Section 3: Governance in small white type at upper left. Extend a thin rule beneath it across the inset page width.

content_islands.name: Section field
content_islands.spec: Fill the remaining page with uninterrupted aubergine.
